dct_creator_sm: Papangelakis, Elli (McMaster University, University of Waterloo, University of Western Ontario). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5365-3505
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the replication data for the paper "Evaluating the impact of sediment seeding strategies in pool-riffle restoration: Experimental insights into hydraulic and spawning habitat performance." It contains the orthophotos, bed elevation DEMs, alluvial cover maps, and grain size distribution data for the described experiments.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Evaluating the impact of sediment seeding strategies in pool-riffle restoration: Experimental insights into hydraulic and spawning habitat performance
